name: PagerDuty MCP Server
summary: PagerDuty-hosted MCP server (US and EU endpoints, OAuth 2.1/CIMD) for incidents, on-call, services and change events. The older self-hosted pagerduty-mcp-server repo is archived and deprecated.
description: Two things share this name. (1) Current: the PagerDuty-hosted MCP server, documented at https://docs.pagerduty.com/ai-automation/advance/pagerduty-mcp-server. Agents act with the permissions of the PagerDuty user who signs in; they can list and triage incidents, check on-call, look up services, teams and escalation policies, review change events, and take actions such as acknowledging, resolving or adding notes to incidents. Docs list US endpoint https://mcp.pagerduty.com/mcp and EU endpoint https://mcp.eu.pagerduty.com/mcp. Auth is OAuth 2.1 with Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD, for listed clients after an admin installs the client app once) or a client ID and secret from an OAuth app you register in PagerDuty; Dynamic Client Registration is not supported. AI-agent tools (such as Paige, PagerDuty's SRE agent) require PagerDuty Advance, the Reliability Platform or AI Actions; some tools are Early Access. Probe 2026-11-28 (unauthenticated, no tool calls): GET and POST initialize on the US endpoint both returned HTTP 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer ... resource_metadata="https://mcp.pagerduty.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp"`. (2) Dead repo: github.com/PagerDuty/pagerduty-mcp-server (Apache-2.0) is deprecated, archived and read-only; its README and the docs both say development moved to the hosted server, and the old local server (`uvx pagerduty-mcp` with a PAGERDUTY_USER_API_KEY, read-only tools by default, --enable-write-tools to modify) should not be chosen for new use. Pricing for the hosted MCP is not stated on the docs page; a PagerDuty account is required and plan terms are separate. No account was created and nothing was installed.

agent_access.notes: Hosted Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 (CIMD or registered client id/secret; no DCR). US https://mcp.pagerduty.com/mcp, EU https://mcp.eu.pagerduty.com/mcp. Probe 2026-11-28: unauthenticated GET and initialize both 401 with OAuth resource_metadata. The old local repo is archived; do not use it for new setups. No tool calls, no sign-in.
